source_operation.summary: Search all S3 credentials with filters

request.scope: account IAM; project_id is an explicit target/filter, not project auth scope
request.identity: exact IAM user/service-user parent and access key; current-user route is explicitly relative to the selected authenticated subject
request.body: source-only name/project_id; SDK refs omitted; required name and target project checked before I/O
request.query: all documented filters; no hidden project or user choice

response.field_mapping: all source fields; secret_key ProtectedValue; server ref discarded; target project and supplied user filters checked when returned
response.resource_ref: access_key identifies the credential; exact parent/scope/generation/endpoint retained; trustworthy accepted key retained before malformed secret decode

errors.transport_loss: unknown_outcome after possible transmission; known exact refs preserved
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error with accepted Receipt and trustworthy key ref
errors.foreign_project_or_parent: scope_mismatch; do not adopt foreign credential

retry: bounded safe reads; mutations single attempt; no replay

recovery.availability: exact observation only where source provides it; no adoption or rotation replay

rotation: no atomic rotation operation; explicit create/install/use/delete steps retain independent results and outcomes; no automatic revoke/rollback
